info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Disputes-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Dispute Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of utility billing disputes. This endpoint is essential for consumers seeking to understand the disputes associated with their utility bills, facilitating efficient issue resolution. By providing detailed information about each dispute, the API supports customer service representatives and billing departments in managing and addressing customer concerns. Typical use cases include investigating billing issues, tracking dispute statuses, and enhancing customer communication related to billing inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific billing dispute. You can use various query parameters to filter the disputes based on status, date, or associated user.

requestBody.description: Request body for querying billing disputes. This contains necessary parameters to filter and retrieve specific dispute records based on the provided criteria.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing disputes. It should contain a string representation of relevant data.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_201.title: Billing Dispute Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the billing dispute.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the billing dispute.

state.description: The current state of the billing dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the billing dispute.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_201.description: This schema represents the response for the Billing Dispute operation on a GET request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the dispute.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the dispute was created, in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the dispute was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information about the audit related to the billing dispute.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total processing time taken by the server to handle the request, expressed in milliseconds.

schema.description: The duration, in milliseconds, that the request took to process on the server.
